subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace discovery silently omit hooks whose package.json or HOOK.md exceeds 1 MiB, or emit a recovery-oriented warning?
rationale: The limit can disable a previously discoverable hook after upgrade, and repository history does not establish whether silent omission is the intended user-facing compatibility contract.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Keep the safety limit but log a focused warning identifying the oversized hook metadata and the recovery action.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like other invalid workspace hook input and intentionally omit it without a user-facing message.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Keep the safety limit but log a focused warning identifying the oversized hook metadata and the recovery action.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history most directly owns hook workspace discovery behavior and its existing warning policy.
